parameters.description: Optional. An AIP-160 (https://google.aip.dev/160) filter expression restricting which devices are returned. An empty filter returns all devices. description: Lists information about the supported locations for this service. This method lists locations based on the resource scope provided in the ListLocationsRequest.name field: * **Global locations**: If `name` is empty, the method lists the public locations available to all projects. * **Project-specific locations**: If `name` follows the format `projects/{project}`, the method lists locations visible to that specific project. This includes public, private, or other project-specific locations enabled for the project. For gRPC and client library implementations, the resource name is passed as the `name` field. For direct service calls, the resource name is incorporated into the request path based on the specific service implementation and version.

description: Starts asynchronous cancellation on a long-running operation. The server makes a best effort to cancel the operation, but success is not guaranteed. If the server doesn't support this method, it returns `google.rpc.Code.UNIMPLEMENTED`. Clients can use Operations.GetOperation or other methods to check whether the cancellation succeeded or whether the operation completed despite cancellation. On successful cancellation, the operation is not deleted; instead, it becomes an operation with an Operation.error value with a google.rpc.Status.code of `1`, corresponding to `Code.CANCELLED`.

description: Android-specific device attributes.
name: CatalogAndroidDeviceDetails

buildType.description: Output only. Mirrors the AOSP `ro.build.type` property, e.g. "user", "userdebug", "eng". Empty if unknown.

supportedAbis.description: Output only. Lists ABIs supported by the device (android.os.Build.SUPPORTED_ABIS), most preferred first, e.g. "arm64-v8a".

description: AndroidX Test Orchestrator-specific attributes. Reserved for future orchestrator-only fields.
name: CatalogAndroidxTestOrchestratorDetails

description: Per-product metadata for the Automation (DeviceRun) product.
name: CatalogAutomationSupport

description: A single routable device configuration in the catalog.
name: CatalogDevice

accessDeniedReasons.description: Output only. Reasons for access denial. This model is accessible/usable if this list is empty, otherwise the model is viewable only.

androidDetails.description: Output only. Contains Android-specific attributes (set when platform == ANDROID).

availability.description: Output only. Reports the current fleet availability for this device configuration.

displayName.description: Output only. Provides a human-readable display name, e.g. "Pixel 5".

formFactor.description: Output only. Specifies the form factor of the device.

hardwareType.description: Output only. Indicates whether the device is physical or virtual.

iosDetails.description: Output only. Contains iOS-specific attributes (set when platform == IOS).

labInfo.description: Output only. The lab hosting this device.

labels.description: Output only. Additional information. Informational only. May change over the lifecycle of a device.

lifecycle.description: Output only. The device lifecycle (maturity stage and removal date).

manufacturer.description: Output only. Specifies the hardware manufacturer of the device.

modelCode.description: Output only. Provides a human-readable model identifier for this device, independent of OS version. May be empty. Platform-dependent: * Android physical: hardware codename (android.os.Build.DEVICE), e.g. "shiba". * Android virtual: AVD model identifier, e.g. "MediumPhone.arm". * iOS: model identifier, e.g. "iphone14pro".

name.description: Identifier. Identifies the device resource. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/devices/{device}`. The {device} segment is an opaque, stable string. Clients must not parse it to derive or assume device-specific details.

osVersion.description: Output only. Specifies the OS version, e.g. "30" (Android API level) or "17.4" (iOS).

platform.description: Output only. Specifies the platform of the device.

primaryScreen.description: Output only. Measurements of the primary device screen. Informational only. Unset for devices without a screen (e.g. some wearables).

supportedProducts.description: Output only. Products/Services supported by this device.

description: Fleet availability for a device configuration.
name: CatalogDeviceAvailability

available.description: Output only. Specifies the current availability bucket (idle, immediately allocatable devices) for this device configuration. This is a best-effort snapshot, refreshed periodically. It fluctuates depending on traffic as other requests allocate devices.

capacity.description: Output only. Specifies the current capacity bucket for this device configuration. Represents the total number of online devices (idle or in use).

description: Per-product metadata for the DeviceStreaming product.
name: CatalogDeviceStreamingSupport

minimumAndroidStudioVersion.description: Output only. Specifies the minimum Android Studio version that supports this device. Optional; only set when the device is known to work only at or above a certain Android Studio version. Expected format "major.minor.micro.patch", e.g. "5921.22.2211.8881706".

description: iOS-specific device attributes. Reserved for future iOS-only fields.
name: CatalogIosDeviceDetails

description: The lab hosting a device.
name: CatalogLabInfo

displayName.description: Output only. Display name of the lab where the device is hosted. If empty, the device is hosted in a Google owned lab.

regionCode.description: Output only. The Unicode country/region code (CLDR) of the lab where the device is hosted, e.g. "US" for United States, "KR" for South Korea. Empty when the hosting region is not published.

description: Catalog resource lifecycle: maturity state plus key lifecycle dates.
name: CatalogLifecycle

removalDate.description: Output only. Specifies the date the resource is scheduled to be removed from the catalog. Only set when `state == DEPRECATED`.

state.description: Output only. Specifies the current maturity state of the resource.

description: Response including listed devices.
name: CatalogListDevicesResponse

nextPageToken.description: Token to receive the next page of devices. This will be absent if the end of the response list has been reached.

description: Response including listed software versions.
name: CatalogListSoftwareVersionsResponse

nextPageToken.description: Token to receive the next page of software versions. This will be absent if the end of the response list has been reached.

description: Screen measurements of a device.
name: CatalogScreenMetrics

densityDpi.description: Output only. Pixel density in dots per inch (dpi).

description: A single software version in the catalog.
name: CatalogSoftwareVersion

androidxTestOrchestratorDetails.description: Output only. Contains AndroidX Test Orchestrator-specific attributes (set when software_type == ANDROIDX_TEST_ORCHESTRATOR).

displayName.description: Output only. Provides a human-readable name for this version, e.g. "AndroidX Test Orchestrator 1.4.1".

isDefault.description: Output only. Indicates whether the system uses this version when a request does not select one explicitly. Exactly one version per `software_type` is the default, and it may change over time.

lifecycle.description: Output only. The version lifecycle (maturity stage and removal date).

name.description: Identifier. Identifies the software version resource. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/softwareVersions/{software_version}`. The {software_version} segment is an opaque, stable string. Clients must not parse it to derive or assume the version.

softwareType.description: Output only. Specifies which software this is a version of. Filter on this field to narrow the collection to a single kind of software, for example `software_type = "ANDROIDX_TEST_ORCHESTRATOR"`.

version.description: Output only. Specifies the version identifier, e.g. "1.4.1". Unique within a `software_type`.

xcodeDetails.description: Output only. Contains Xcode-specific attributes (set when software_type == XCODE).

description: Declares that a device supports a given Device Cloud product, with optional per-product metadata. Discriminated by which product-specific message is set; adding a new product = new oneof arm + new per-product message.
name: CatalogSupportedProduct

automation.description: Output only. Represents Automation, which is DeviceRun-backed automated test execution.

deviceStreaming.description: Output only. Represents DeviceStreaming, which is interactive remote device streaming.

description: Xcode-specific attributes.
name: CatalogXcodeDetails

supportedIosVersions.description: Output only. Lists the iOS versions this Xcode can run tests against, e.g. "16.6". This is a property of the toolchain, so it says nothing about whether a device on that iOS version is available; list the `Device` collection to find out.

description: Represents a whole or partial calendar date, such as a birthday. The time of day and time zone are either specified elsewhere or are insignificant. The date is relative to the Gregorian Calendar. This can represent one of the following: * A full date, with non-zero year, month, and day values. * A month and day, with a zero year (for example, an anniversary). * A year on its own, with a zero month and a zero day. * A year and month, with a zero day (for example, a credit card expiration date). Related types: * google.type.TimeOfDay * google.type.DateTime * google.protobuf.Timestamp
name: Date

day.description: Day of a month. Must be from 1 to 31 and valid for the year and month, or 0 to specify a year by itself or a year and month where the day isn't significant.

month.description: Month of a year. Must be from 1 to 12, or 0 to specify a year without a month and day.

year.description: Year of the date. Must be from 1 to 9999, or 0 to specify a date without a year.

description: A generic empty message that you can re-use to avoid defining duplicated empty messages in your APIs. A typical example is to use it as the request or the response type of an API method. For instance: service Foo { rpc Bar(google.protobuf.Empty) returns (google.protobuf.Empty); }
name: Empty

description: The request message for Operations.CancelOperation.
name: GoogleLongrunningCancelOperationRequest

description: The response message for Operations.ListOperations.
name: GoogleLongrunningListOperationsResponse

operations.description: A list of operations that matches the specified filter in the request.

unreachable.description: Unordered list. Unreachable resources. Populated when the request sets `ListOperationsRequest.return_partial_success` and reads across collections. For example, when attempting to list all resources across all supported locations.

description: This resource represents a long-running operation that is the result of a network API call.
name: GoogleLongrunningOperation

done.description: If the value is `false`, it means the operation is still in progress. If `true`, the operation is completed, and either `error` or `response` is available.

error.description: The error result of the operation in case of failure or cancellation.

metadata.description: Service-specific metadata associated with the operation. It typically contains progress information and common metadata such as create time. Some services might not provide such metadata. Any method that returns a long-running operation should document the metadata type, if any.

name.description: The server-assigned name, which is only unique within the same service that originally returns it. If you use the default HTTP mapping, the `name` should be a resource name ending with `operations/{unique_id}`.

response.description: The normal, successful response of the operation. If the original method returns no data on success, such as `Delete`, the response is `google.protobuf.Empty`. If the original method is standard `Get`/`Create`/`Update`, the response should be the resource. For other methods, the response should have the type `XxxResponse`, where `Xxx` is the original method name. For example, if the original method name is `TakeSnapshot()`, the inferred response type is `TakeSnapshotResponse`.

description: The `Status` type defines a logical error model that is suitable for different programming environments, including REST APIs and RPC APIs. It is used by [gRPC](https://github.com/grpc). Each `Status` message contains three pieces of data: error code, error message, and error details. You can find out more about this error model and how to work with it in the [API Design Guide](https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/errors).
name: GoogleRpcStatus

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of google.rpc.Code.

details.description: A list of messages that carry the error details. There is a common set of message types for APIs to use.

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the google.rpc.Status.details field, or localized by the client.

description: The response message for Locations.ListLocations.
name: ListLocationsResponse

locations.description: A list of locations that matches the specified filter in the request.

description: A resource that represents a Google Cloud location.
name: Location

displayName.description: The friendly name for this location, typically a nearby city name. For example, "Tokyo".

labels.description: Cross-service attributes for the location. For example {"cloud.googleapis.com/region": "us-east1"}

locationId.description: The canonical id for this location. For example: `"us-east1"`.

metadata.description: Service-specific metadata. For example the available capacity at the given location.

name.description: Resource name for the location, which may vary between implementations. For example: `"projects/example-project/locations/us-east1"`
